words.definition: pleased about something you or someone close to you has done
worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen
words.example: I always feel {nervous} before a test.

words.definition: wanting to know or learn about something
words.example: The {curious} cat looked inside the box.

words.definition: wanting to thank someone for something they did
sad because you have no one to be with or talk to
words.example: He felt {lonely} in the new town.

words.definition: quiet and not worried or excited
words.example: Take a deep breath and stay {calm}.
